meta.name: customize
meta.description: Add new capabilities or modify NanoClaw behavior. Use when user wants to add channels (Telegram, Slack, email input), change triggers, add integrations, modify the router, or make any other customizations. This is an interactive skill that asks questions to understand what the user wants.

copy.tagline: 扩展 NanoClaw,接入新渠道、调整触发与路由。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果想按需扩展 NanoClaw 的功能和连接。
copy.tagline_en: Extend NanoClaw with new channels, triggers, and integrations.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to customize NanoClaw's behavior and add new capabilities.

howto.what: 这个技能让 Claude 帮你调整 NanoClaw:添加新输入渠道(如 Telegram、Slack)、改触发词或接入其他服务。它会先提问确认改动目标,再修改配置并给你重启验证步骤。
howto.when: 当你对 Claude 提出要新增渠道(如 Telegram、Slack)、换触发词或接新服务等定制需求时触发,它会先提问弄清你想怎么改再动手。

say.text: 帮我接入 Telegram 作为输入渠道。
say.note: 会先问接到哪个对话组,再执行安装。

say.text: 把触发词改成“汇报”,不要再用“报告”。
say.note: 它会更新该对话组的触发规则。

say.text: 给我的机器人加一个 Gmail 集成。
say.note: 会先确认给哪个对话组用,再完成设置。

howto.what_en: This skill lets Claude modify NanoClaw: add input channels (e.g. Telegram, Slack), change triggers, or connect other services. It asks clarifying questions, then edits the relevant config and tells you how to apply the change.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask Claude to add a channel (Telegram, Slack, etc.), change trigger rules, or add other integrations to NanoClaw.

say_en.text: Add Telegram as an input channel.
say_en.note: It asks which group should receive it, then installs.

say_en.text: Change the trigger from “报告” to “汇报”.
say_en.note: It updates that channel's trigger rules.

say_en.text: Add a Gmail integration to my bot.
say_en.note: It asks which group needs it, then configures it.
